_comment: Mutation testing for the two highest-value logic units: quota enforcement and tenant resolution. Report-only — the 80% target is surfaced, not enforced (break: null), so a first run never fails CI. Run from packages/core with `npx stryker run` (unit specs run against source via bin/test.ts; bring Redis up on 127.0.0.1:56379 if you include quota_service paths that touch it).
